title: Finite-open descent of constant-model cohomology
statement: For any commutative condensed ring Lambda, any Noetherian scheme X, a finite family of opens U_i covering X, and an ambient derived module object M, suppose every derived restriction M|U_i is bounded with finite-constant-model constructible cohomology. Then for every integer q, H^q(M) is finite-constant-model constructible on X. No assertion of global boundedness is part of this conclusion.

proof.text: Exact Cartesian module inverse image commutes with derived cohomology via leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory and mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso. Reindex the finite cover by Fin n, and choose its finite local stratifications. Put V_a equal to the union of the earlier opens W_b for b<a. For every stratum T_ab inside W_a, pull back its immersion into X along the reduced closed subscheme of X supported on the complement of V_a. These fibre products are locally closed constructible subschemes because X is Noetherian; they are disjoint (the first containing open index decides a point), and cover X (choose that least index). The resulting Stratification has actual projections into the original strata. Pull back their witnessing pro-etale covers and their fixed finitely presented scalar modules. upperStarComp and the point-pullback comparison, with extension/comap cancellation, identify the scalar model on each new cover member with the original scalar module pulled back from the point. This proves constructibility of every global cohomology object. Empty covers give an empty stratification automatically.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1), implemented by disjoint-first-open refinement and canonical Cartesian pullback/cohomology comparisons

lean.statement:
theorem cohomology_finiteOpenDescent
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (I : Type w) [Finite I] (U : I → X.Opens)
    (hcover : iSup U = ⊤) (M : Ambient Λ X)
    (hM : ∀ i : I, generators Λ (U i).toScheme ((pull Λ (U i).ι).obj M)) :
    ∀ n : ℤ, IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj M)
